basic_info.description: Prime Sunnyside! Upon entering this lovely corner home you can't help but experience the WOW FACTOR! The 3 story remodeled open floor plan & fresh modern design is stunning! A spectacular dramatic staircase, an exquisitely designed fireplace with floor-to-ceiling hearth & a seamless connection between the rooms it offers a beautiful contemporary layout. The expertly designed space exudes, comfort, warmth, & is conducive to today's modern lifestyle. The awesome floor plan with over 2500sqft offers convenience with easy access from the great rm & kitchen to the spectacular view deck & exquisitely landscaped garden with hot tub & fire pit. Access to the backyard from the lower level creates a chic indoor-outdoor flow from both floors. State of the art kitchen, great rm, spacious living & dining rm, sensational primary en-suite, 3 bdrms, 2.5 remod baths, media rm, lg garage. Great neighborhood! Close to shops schools, restaurants, & transportation, 2 EV chargers in garage.
